FN-MDASHW1-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 109
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Chris Pringle
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 109 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board of Podiatry until
October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or
local funding.
Page 1
